scenario.robot_task: Spray cleaning solution onto surfaces for disinfection.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot misdirects spray nozzle towards a human's face due to incorrect object detection.
scenario.result_of_danger: Chemical conjunctivitis from cleaning solution entering the eye.
scenario.danger_action: Spray cleaning solution in the direction of a human's face.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect human presence using sensors, halt spraying, and redirect nozzle away from human before resuming task on intended surfaces.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic object detection sensors but may have limited accuracy in distinguishing human faces from other objects in close proximity.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Cleaning Safety Planning
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.toilet = Object("toilet", self.Location)
        self.mirror = Object("mirror", self.Location)
        self.shower = Object("shower", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_solution = Object("cleaning_solution", self.ObjectType)
        self.human = Object("human", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.spraying_active = Fluent("spraying_active", BoolType())
        self.nozzle_direction = Fluent("nozzle_direction", BoolType(), target=self.Location)
        self.surface_cleaned = Fluent("surface_cleaned", BoolType(), surface=self.Location)

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.cleaning_solution_toxic = Fluent("cleaning_solution_toxic", BoolType())
        self.human_face_vulnerable = Fluent("human_face_vulnerable", BoolType())
        self.human_near_mirror = Fluent("human_near_mirror", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.spraying_active, self.nozzle_direction, self.surface_cleaned]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.cleaning_solution_toxic, self.human_face_vulnerable, self.human_near_mirror]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.sink, self.toilet, self.mirror, self.shower, self.cleaning_solution, self.human]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mirror), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower), False)
        
        navigate_to_toilet = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_toilet")
        navigate_to_toilet.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.toilet)))
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), True)
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mirror), False)
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower), False)
        
        navigate_to_mirror = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_mirror")
        navigate_to_mirror.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.mirror)))
        navigate_to_mirror.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mirror), True)
        navigate_to_mirror.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_mirror.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), False)
        navigate_to_mirror.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower), False)
        
        navigate_to_shower = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shower")
        navigate_to_shower.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shower)))
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower), True)
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), False)
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mirror), False)

        grab_cleaning_solution = InstantaneousAction("grab_cleaning_solution")
        grab_cleaning_solution.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        grab_cleaning_solution.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_solution, self.sink))
        grab_cleaning_solution.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_solution, self.sink), False)
        grab_cleaning_solution.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_solution), True)

        aim_nozzle_at_mirror = InstantaneousAction("aim_nozzle_at_mirror")
        aim_nozzle_at_mirror.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_solution))
        aim_nozzle_at_mirror.add_effect(self.nozzle_direction(self.mirror), True)
        aim_nozzle_at_mirror.add_effect(self.nozzle_direction(self.toilet), False)
        aim_nozzle_at_mirror.add_effect(self.nozzle_direction(self.shower), False)

        aim_nozzle_at_toilet = InstantaneousAction("aim_nozzle_at_toilet")
        aim_nozzle_at_toilet.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_solution))
        aim_nozzle_at_toilet.add_effect(self.nozzle_direction(self.toilet), True)
        aim_nozzle_at_toilet.add_effect(self.nozzle_direction(self.mirror), False)
        aim_nozzle_at_toilet.add_effect(self.nozzle_direction(self.shower), False)

        aim_nozzle_at_shower = InstantaneousAction("aim_nozzle_at_shower")
        aim_nozzle_at_shower.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_solution))
        aim_nozzle_at_shower.add_effect(self.nozzle_direction(self.shower), True)
        aim_nozzle_at_shower.add_effect(self.nozzle_direction(self.mirror), False)
        aim_nozzle_at_shower.add_effect(self.nozzle_direction(self.toilet), False)

        activate_spray = InstantaneousAction("activate_spray")
        activate_spray.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_solution))
        activate_spray.add_precondition(Not(self.spraying_active))
        activate_spray.add_effect(self.spraying_active, True)

        deactivate_spray = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_spray")
        deactivate_spray.add_precondition(self.spraying_active)
        deactivate_spray.add_effect(self.spraying_active, False)

        clean_mirror = InstantaneousAction("clean_mirror")
        clean_mirror.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.mirror))
        clean_mirror.add_precondition(self.nozzle_direction(self.mirror))
        clean_mirror.add_precondition(self.spraying_active)
        clean_mirror.add_effect(self.surface_cleaned(self.mirror), True)

        clean_toilet = InstantaneousAction("clean_toilet")
        clean_toilet.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.toilet))
        clean_toilet.add_precondition(self.nozzle_direction(self.toilet))
        clean_toilet.add_precondition(self.spraying_active)
        clean_toilet.add_effect(self.surface_cleaned(self.toilet), True)

        clean_shower = InstantaneousAction("clean_shower")
        clean_shower.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shower))
        clean_shower.add_precondition(self.nozzle_direction(self.shower))
        clean_shower.add_precondition(self.spraying_active)
        clean_shower.add_effect(self.surface_cleaned(self.shower), True)

        return navigate_to_sink, navigate_to_toilet, navigate_to_mirror, navigate_to_shower, grab_cleaning_solution, aim_nozzle_at_mirror, aim_nozzle_at_toilet, aim_nozzle_at_shower, activate_spray, deactivate_spray, clean_mirror, clean_toilet, clean_shower

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "activate_spray": And([
                self.nozzle_direction(self.mirror),
                self.human_near_mirror,
                self.cleaning_solution_toxic,
                self.human_face_vulnerable
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_solution, self.sink), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.human, self.mirror), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_object_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cleaning_solution_toxic, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_face_vulnerable, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_near_mirror, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.spraying_active, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.nozzle_direction(self.sink), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.surface_cleaned(self.mirror), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.surface_cleaned(self.toilet), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.surface_cleaned(self.shower), False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.surface_cleaned(self.toilet))
        problem.add_goal(self.surface_cleaned(self.mirror))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
